request: Correct the R-004 render so the compact puja turns perpendicular to the TV/stair wall, while retaining the corrected 381 mm projected TV unit and open puja standing zone.
source_conflicts: R-004 QA found the rendered puja front appeared parallel to the TV wall, conflicting with the approved perpendicular puja relationship.
proposal: Maintain the R-004 projecting TV unit and all other layout elements. Rotate the compact puja 90 degrees so its front faces the kitchen/Bedroom-3 approach and its narrow side—not its front—reads toward the TV/living view. Keep the puja separate from TV joinery and preserve the open one-person standing zone.
risks_and_dependencies: Puja pocket-fold door travel and diya-tray operation require a measured mock-up.
The projected TV unit and overhead storage still require site verification and independent fixing.
validation_plan: Check that puja visibly reads perpendicular to the TV wall and remains separate.
Check that TV volume remains visibly projected and puja standing zone is unobstructed.
Obtain independent QA; no promotion requested.

results: The TV/console/overhead-storage volume visibly projects from a recessed wall line.
The puja now turns perpendicular: its narrow side reads toward the living/TV view while its front faces the kitchen approach.
Exact 381 mm projection, TV size, puja standing clearance and door/tray operations remain site/shop-drawing checks.

open_next_actions: Preserve as withdrawn draft history; do not use for design or fabrication.
